column3: Then you're not the\nthieves. I'm relieved.{end_wait}
Something isn't right...{pause_20_skippable}\nYou{pause_20_skippable} took it, didn't you?{end_wait}
The roads are empty.\nHow will we stay open?{end_wait}
Our guests were gone\nwhen the mountain shook.{page_break}They came back later.\nI didn't ask where.{end_wait}
People blame our guests.{page_break}But suspicion isn't\nproof.{page_break}They've been polite\nand paid for their rooms.{end_wait}
The innkeeper trusts\nthose three.{page_break}I don't. I've seen\nhow they watch the door.{end_wait}
That boy, {actor_name:3},\nstared right through me.{page_break}I felt exposed.\nI didn't like it.{end_wait}
We've done nothing!{page_break}You can't accuse us\nwithout proof.{end_wait}
If our guests did it,\nwhat happens to the inn?{end_wait}
The eruption nearly\nruined our business.{page_break}Those three pay well.\nWe need the money.{end_wait}
The owners need money.{page_break}They won't ask questions\nabout those guests.{end_wait}
They're watching us.\nThey know we're close.{end_wait}
They run whenever\nwe get near. What now?{end_now}
We need to stop them\nlong enough for Ivan.{end_wait}
We can't catch all three\nat once.{end_wait}
Then we split them up.\nCorner one at a time.{end_wait}
Don't let them touch you!\nKeep your distance!{end_wait}
What's he doing?!\nGet away from me!{end_wait}
They took the rod.\nAnd other things too.{end_wait}
The goods are hidden\nsomewhere in this inn.{end_wait}
They won't let me\nnear them again.{end_wait}
Then we search the inn.\nIt's our only lead.{end_now}
Then I suppose\nwe'll have to wait.{end_wait}
I believe you can do it.{end_wait}
There were crates\nblocking the loft.{page_break}I went to move them{pause_20_skippable}\nand someone hit me.{end_wait}
I woke up tied here.{page_break}I never saw who\ndid it.{end_wait}
Even if we give it back,\nwe're still going to jail?{end_wait}
They're just children.\nDon't worry about them.{end_wait}
